body.name: Certified finite legality procedure
body.construction: Generate the at most \(N!\) saturated ordered super-architectures, enumerate their dense deterministic table systems, expand every coordinate of \(\Phi_T\) and every \(Z_e\) as a rational polynomial, and introduce \(t\) through \(\Phi_T(p_T)_n-t\Phi_T(p_T)_d=0\).  Form \(\mathsf{Lift}(t)\) as the finite disjunction over table systems and \(G\in\mathcal G(\mathcal P)\).  A one-block existential semialgebraic elimination algorithm based on critical points computes an exact univariate sign description of the attainable \(t\)-set and isolates its algebraic infimum and supremum when it is nonempty.  At each isolated closure endpoint it decides \(\mathsf{Lift}(t)\).  The certificate \(\mathsf{Cert}(t)\) is a Thom-encoded real-univariate sample point for a satisfying branch, or the exact block-elimination sign data showing that every bounded finite branch is empty.  A sign-invariant cylindrical decomposition may optionally expand the latter data, but is not used for the intrinsic complexity bound.
